title: eritrichium spathulatum
intro: Eritrichium spathulatum, commonly known as Western fescue or Spurred fescue, is a perennial plant in the borage family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eritrichium spathulatum may include soothing irritated tissues, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
